title: SNAP Participation, Administrative Cost Shifts, and Measurement Loss
discussion_signal: The commentary contrasts falling SNAP participation with rising administrative cost responsibility for states and warns that participation counts cannot identify who lost eligibility or who remains food insecure, especially after the national household food-security survey ended.
linked_research_question: How should changes in SNAP scale and administrative responsibility be interpreted when participation is observable but underlying need and food insecurity become harder to measure?
limits: The post uses preliminary comparison figures and warns against treating participation as need
It is an analyst's commentary rather than a causal evaluation
